The VLC engine is a fallback for old/rare formats ExoPlayer cannot open (WMV, RealMedia, broken AVI, etc.). It has a simpler interface: play/pause, seeking, audio and subtitle selection, speed, external subtitles.

HW: the system\'s hardware decoder, uses the least battery. HW+: uses FFmpeg for formats the hardware does not support. SW: CPU decoding with FFmpeg first. It can also be changed during playback from the label at the top.
